title: The Woman with the Perfume
reflectionQuestion: Have you ever given something that cost you everything, without knowing if it would be received?
reflectionText: She was not invited. She did not belong. And she came anyway, with tears and perfume and hair she loosened in a room full of men who judged her for it. Jesus did not name her sin — he named her love. What is it to give everything you have, completely, in front of people who can only see what it costs you in their eyes?

scriptureKeyVerse.text: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”
